# mapstructure

This package is a fork of [`github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2`](https://github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2).

mapstructure is a Go library for decoding generic map values to structures.
See the upstream
[documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2) for usage and examples.
